method: Original STL loaded process=False; triangle rays, original triangle normals, first solid interval and outside/inside/outside controls. No repaired geometry or idealized mesh substitution. Authored coordinates define probes only. Rays are local sampled controls, not exhaustive minimum thickness or printability certification.
section_method: Original STL triangle-plane canonical edge interpolation; six-decimal endpoint graph must close at degree two, every original Polygon must be valid. No simplify, buffer(0), repair, or ideal-shape replacement. Two original levels at central z +/-0.2 mm are intersected. Side ROI x beyond +/-30.3m separates crown and parapet; each actual support must retain one nonempty 0.4mm erosion core. Erosion is diagnostic only, never replacement geometry.

first_gap_assessment.classification: Parapet first exit is its opposite original arc face at the same height; the following void is the intentionally open terrace between parapet and inset crown. Both inward/outward normal probes verify outside/inside/outside parity, and independent upward terrace probes verify opening to sky. Not a hidden cavity under a thin surface.

numerical_controls: Coincident triangle-edge hit distances within 1e-7 mm are one crossing. Dome normals avoid the y=0 shared-facet seam using predeclared theta .013 and root y .037 m. Thickness thresholds are unchanged. This de-duplicates intersections only; the original STL is never modified.
